items.headline: Eight goals at Old Trafford — Man United claw back a wild 4-4 with Villa
items.body: United were two goals down inside four minutes and still trailed 4-2 in stoppage time, then Patrick Dorgu's last-gasp strike rescued a 4-4. It's the first Premier League game ever where a team twice came back from two goals down.
items.say: Did you catch Man United–Villa? Four-four, and United were basically buried twice — absolute chaos.

items.headline: Liverpool get right back on track — 3-1 at Crystal Palace
items.body: Alexis Mac Allister, Florian Wirtz (his first league goal of the season) and Alexander Isak all scored as Liverpool bounced back at Selhurst Park. Eddie Nketiah's stoppage-time penalty was just a consolation.
items.say: Wirtz finally got off the mark for Liverpool — they looked way more like themselves against Palace.

items.headline: Norris cruises in Brazil — but Verstappen's P21-to-P2 stole the show
items.body: Lando Norris won from pole to stretch his title lead, while Max Verstappen sliced from 21st on the grid all the way to second in a wet-dry thriller at Interlagos. Mercedes wrapped up the Constructors' crown.
items.say: Verstappen started dead last in Brazil and still finished second — how does he even do that?

items.headline: No Luka? No problem — Austin Reaves drops 43 as the Lakers hold off Detroit
items.body: With Luka Dončić out, Austin Reaves went off for 43 points and four threes to carry the Lakers past the Pistons 121-116.
items.say: Austin Reaves put up 43 for the Lakers with Luka sitting — the guy's having a year.

items.headline: Faker's out — BLG finally slay T1 to reach the Worlds final
items.body: Bilibili Gaming beat four-time champions T1 3-1 in the semifinals, ending Faker's title defense. They'll meet Gen.G in the grand final on Nov 14 at Barclays Center in New York.
items.say: T1 are actually OUT of Worlds — BLG finally got them. It's BLG vs Gen.G for the title next weekend.

items.headline: MOUZ sweep The MongolZ 3-0 to win IEM Beijing
items.body: MOUZ didn't drop a single map in the $1.25M Beijing grand final, finally lifting an IEM trophy after years of close calls for in-game leader xertioN.
items.say: MOUZ just 3-0'd the MongolZ to win IEM Beijing without losing a map — ice cold.

items.headline: Godzilla stomps the box office — 'Minus Zero' beats the Cat in the Hat
items.body: The sequel to the Oscar-winning 'Godzilla Minus One' opened at No. 1 this weekend, holding off Bill Hader's 'The Cat in the Hat' for the top spot.
items.say: The new Godzilla won the weekend over the Cat in the Hat movie — kaiju beats cartoon, apparently.

items.headline: Owen Wilson's golf comedy 'Stick' is back for Season 2
items.body: Apple TV's feel-good golf comedy returned Nov 4, with Owen Wilson's washed-up pro chasing a comeback — and Better Call Saul's Rhea Seehorn joining the cast.
items.say: You watching Stick? Owen Wilson as a has-been golfer — second season just dropped.

items.headline: Bryan Adams is back with new music — 'How's It Goin''
items.body: The Canadian rock mainstay dropped a breezy, radio-ready new single this week — pure, instantly recognizable Bryan Adams.
items.say: Bryan Adams put out new music — and it still sounds exactly like Bryan Adams, which is kind of the point.
